text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shortly before the Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
Satono Diamond finally shattered the 
Satono family jinx, claiming a complete 
victory in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the stage shifted to the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). However, that day brought the 
worst foul weather in history, making it a 
race straight through a raging storm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet Kitasan Black remains undaunted. For 
the sake of the fans who came to watch, 
she resolves to plunge fearlessly into the 
rough track.
